a:r.a:t: Turn the completed baseline pipeline into LoRA evidence
Run PhoWhisper-base on the same clean/noisy subset as the Whisper baseline.
Fine-tune PhoWhisper with LoRA on clean VIVOS transcripts and compare to zero-shot.
Train with MUSAN augmentation at 20, 10, 5, and 0 dB to improve noise robustness.
Add decoder-side tone classification head and train with L_ASR + lambda * L_tone.
Report WER/CER/TER/DER by SNR, then run ablation: E3 versus E4.
Decision point: if E4 improves TER/DER without hurting WER/CER, the tone-aware objective is justified.
